_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 84: 22-24 June 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He names the month of December, then December and January, and says he sees them trying to snip his wings.
mentions.quote: The month of December in January. I see trying to snip his wings
mentions.falsify_match: Same event as the surrounding passages.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing new; a fragment inside a longer prophetic flow.

mentions.claim_text: He says December is very bold and January is bold, that he sees the Senate and blue colours, a dark blue and a lighter blue like a plum and a darker blue, that he sees the Senate and sees Thomas, telling them to pray for Thomas and for the Supreme Court, and describes a heavier-set woman with black hair.
mentions.quote: I see the Senate. And I see Thomas. Pray for Thomas
mentions.falsify_match: Something happening to Justice Thomas over that winter.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing does. A named living justice is the checkable part; the colours and the unnamed woman are not. Pray for is not a prediction, so even this names no outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is dominant blue and it is pulsing, that it goes to the Supreme Court and he sees Thomas and the judges in a line trying to do something, and that he sees wings on Trump that are clipped at the tips and shortened so that he is not able to fly.
mentions.quote: I see wings on Trump that are clipped at the tips
mentions.falsify_match: Court and Senate action limiting presidential authority that winter.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Clipped at the tips rather than cut off is a hedge inside the image itself: a partial constraint of any size satisfies it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he could pause on the months and that October is turbulent, September is turbulent and July is turbulent, that he could see Europe and a plan and could see Russia, that he is very hesitant to say what he saw concerning Putin and Zelensky, but will say he saw an assurance of something guaranteed to Putin from Trump, that an agreement was made and something was said, that Putin looked assured because he was promised something and believed it, and that he will say no more because what he saw was bad and he does not want to put anybody in danger.
mentions.quote: I saw an assurance of something that was was guaranteed to Putin
mentions.falsify_match: A private undertaking from the American president to Putin becoming known.
mentions.falsify_miss: None available, because the content is withheld. He says he may be bolder tomorrow and will pray about releasing it. The pattern repeats: the specific and checkable part is named as existing and then not given.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have been praying for Israel and believes this is the attack the Lord showed them, an event in Israel worse than October the 7th, that the Lord said it will happen in the middle of the night and to pray and it will be up by Damascus, that he saw a major attack coming, and that today the IDF captured Hezbollah drones, factories and launch sites hidden inside southern Lebanon.
mentions.quote: in the middle of the night to pray, and it will be up by Damascus
mentions.falsify_match: A night attack on Israel from the direction of Damascus exceeding October 7th.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date. Up by Damascus is a genuinely new and narrowing detail. But weapons being seized is the opposite of an attack occurring, so the fulfilment offered runs against the claim rather than toward it.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will keep messing with your mind and your hormones until it gets hold of you and becomes a stronghold that will destroy you, that whoever this is must get the word of God inside them and it will change them from the inside out, that he does not allow that spirit to get hold of them, and names cigarettes among the things meant.
mentions.quote: it becomes a stronghold and it will destroy you
mentions.condition_text: if you do not get the word of God inside you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: addressed to an unnamed person about an unnamed condition.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a Christian too weak to lift the sword of the spirit and tells them to get muscle and protein in their bones and cut the devil's head off by knowing the word, that within twelve days the devil will be scared of them, using an extended figure of spiritual protein shakes and a spiritual gym, and says it is the anemic Christian the devil runs over.
mentions.quote: It's the anemic Christian that he runs over
mentions.condition_text: if you get the word down inside you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an internal state on a figurative timetable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. The twelve days is worth noting as the only number in the passage, and it belongs to a metaphor rather than to an event.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all falling in line and asks whether they see how Jesus is bringing it about, that Cuba is next and Marco Rubio will run the charge, that the greatest harvest of souls will come in in Cuba, that ten million people live on that island, and that a major harvest is coming to Cuba and they see it now.
mentions.quote: Cuba is next. Marco Rubio will run the charge
mentions.falsify_match: Regime change or mass conversion in Cuba, led politically by Rubio.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither happens. Next has no date. The ten million figure is roughly the island's population, so greatest harvest sets no threshold that could be measured against it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw them poking Putin with long range missiles and that Zelensky flew major drones into Moscow yesterday in the longest drone attack seen, that he told them what he saw coming and saw them hitting the Kremlin in the days ahead with the area around the Kremlin on fire and people running and screaming as long range missiles went into Moscow, that it happened but not with the red tip missiles he saw since they are using drones, that he believes the missiles will happen eventually, and that October 8th is when the Lord showed him long range missiles with a red tip.
mentions.quote: Not the red tip missiles that I saw, but they're using drones
mentions.falsify_match: Red-tipped long range missiles striking Moscow and the Kremlin.
mentions.falsify_miss: Drone attacks only, which is what he reports. He says outright that this is not what he saw, and holds the missile claim open as still to come. That refusal to bank a near miss is worth recording, and it also means the claim cannot expire.

mentions.claim_text: He notes earthquakes going on and one in Greece, says to save that for how they close the news portion, and turns to the lobbying against the Clarity Act and what he told them he saw at the beginning of last week, which he believes was last Sunday.
mentions.quote: the lobbying against uh the Clarity Act and what I told you I saw
mentions.falsify_match: Reported bank lobbying against the bill after the stated word.
mentions.falsify_miss: The lobbying was already public. The origin is given as last Sunday and is inside this corpus, so the ordering can be settled, which is what this claim turns on entirely.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will bring out the mark in the hand and the forehead and you will be able to buy, sell and trade with it, that if you take that mark you are damned for hell forever because that is what the Bible says, that there is no repenting after taking the mark of the beast, and refers to going to the tribulation with Jesus on July the 6th of 2014.
mentions.quote: If you take that mark, you're you're damned for hell for hell forever
mentions.falsify_match: A universal purchase system requiring a bodily mark.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No date is given for the mark itself, and the consequence attached is one no earthly outcome could check.

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes they have three years of this time frame and then go into the shmita cycle into 2029, that 2028 and 2029 are a three-year window, that the new shmita cycle is at the fall of 2028 going all the way into 2029, that he believes Jesus Christ's return is around a shmita cycle, that a shmita cycle is seven years and the tribulation lasts seven years.
mentions.quote: The schmita cycle be it new one is at 2028 fall of 2028
mentions.falsify_match: The tribulation beginning at the 2028 shmita.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not begin. He marks it as belief rather than vision, and the arithmetic is his own: he says three years and then names a window that is two. Recorded as stated.
